source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: For the described moving emergency vehicle, pull parallel and close to the right edge and stop outside intersections unless an officer directs otherwise; opposing traffic across a median need not stop.
corrections.note: The median exception is stated on page 60, not on cited page 59.

corrections.corrected_statement: To check following space, time the gap from a fixed roadside marker; reaching it in less than three seconds is too close, and adversity calls for a longer gap.
corrections.note: Adversity longer-gap rule is on page 75, not page 74.
